name: B10-0127/2025 (PPE) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on the violence in eastern Congo. It condemns Rwanda for sending troops and backing the M23 rebels, and asks Rwanda to pull its soldiers out. It wants all rebel groups shut down, peace talks pushed forward, and more EU money for aid. It also asks the EU to review its support for Rwanda, including a minerals deal, and to consider sanctions if Rwanda does not change course.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking the EU to act, not deciding it.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda, Congo, rebel groups, aid workers and displaced people.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
